text:
kate.ng: Quick sync — I'm about to land a docs PR that updates Dedicated scale-policy examples and tweaks some provisioning links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432. Main changes: new field `max_concurrent_batches` and an explicit `isolation_level` example. Need someone to update SDK snippets (JS + Go) and fix the broken internal anchor in provisioning.md.

jordan: @kate.ng I can take the JS snippet. Will update the SDK example and add a short migration note for customers. Planning a small PR against docs repo.

sam: I'll handle the Go SDK sample and the terraform example in the migration guide. Quick Q: do we want the migration note to recommend `isolation_level: strict` for regulated workloads?

maria: +1 on recommending `strict` for regulated. Also saw the SLA wording — we should replace the word "eviction" with "preemption" in the isolation section to reduce confusion. I'll review wording in provisioning.md once snippets land.

docs-bot: automated-link-checker: provisioning.md -> broken anchor: `#capacity-isolation` at line 214. Suggested anchor: `#isolation-and-preemption`.

kate.ng: thanks — that broken anchor is what I mentioned. Please also update the internal crosslink from /dedicated/overview to the provisioning page.

jordan: putting up a tiny PR for JS snippet now. Draft of sample (will push shortly):
```js
// create dedicated scale policy with new batching param
const policy = {
  name: 'batch-high-throughput',
  max_concurrent_batches: 8,
  target_latency_ms: 120,
  isolation_level: 'balanced' // options: balanced | strict | best-effort
};
await client.dedicated.createScalePolicy(policy);
```
I'll include a migration note: existing `max_batches` -> `max_concurrent_batches` rename.

sam: here's Go snippet I'm going to add to docs:
```go
policy := inference.ScalePolicy{
  Name: "batch-high-throughput",
  MaxConcurrentBatches: 8,
  TargetLatencyMs: 120,
  IsolationLevel: "balanced",
}
client.CreateScalePolicy(ctx, policy)
```
Also adding terraform example with the new `isolation_level` enum mapping.

maria: small wording suggestion for SLA paragraph: "Dedicated SLA covers up to the configured capacity; preemption behavior for strict isolation may route to fallback model variants — customers should pin a fallback model to avoid QoS regressions." I'll paste an inline edit in the PR review.

devex-bot: preview build: docs build passed with warnings. Fenced code blocks need language tag for syntax highlighting (JS/Go). Also the migration note triggered the changelog lint rule — please add `migration: yes` to frontmatter.

kate.ng: perfect. Can we aim to merge all snippet PRs within the next 24 hours? We want the console rollout to reference the updated docs tomorrow afternoon. Tag me and @maria for final review.

jordan: will do. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/433 (JS snippet).

sam: PR link for Go + terraform: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/434.

maria: I'll review both in the next hour. I'll also push the anchor/link fix in a separate tiny PR if anyone's blocked by merge order.

kate.ng: thanks team. After merge, I'll update the release note and add a short section in the Dedicated migration checklist about `max_concurrent_batches` and `isolation_level`. :thumbsup:
